templates.title: Maily
templates.name: maily
templates.description: The Universal Temporary Email Gateway: aggregate 8+ disposable mail providers under one REST API & dark-mode dashboard with instant OTP verification code extraction. Source: https://github.com/stormsia/maily

env.name: MAILY_API_KEY
env.label: API Key
env.description: Root master API key for authentication and dashboard access

templates.note:
Access the dark-mode dashboard and REST API at http://<your-host>:8477.
Interactive API documentation (Swagger UI) is available at http://<your-host>:8477/docs.
Persistent data (SQLite database and encryption key) is stored in /data.
